Sr. Manager, Data Platform Engineering
Boston, MA
About SimpliSafe 
 We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here. 
We’re embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.
 Why are we hiring? 
 Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.
 About the Job 
 SimpliSafe has quickly emerged as a leader in the home security space, thanks to our commitment to innovation and customer-centric solutions. We’re seeking individuals to join our growing team to help carry out our mission to make every customer feel safe and secure in their home.
 We’re investing in a multi-quarter Enterprise Data Platform program to move our data and analytics stack onto a modern lakehouse. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data Platform Engineering to lead the team that builds, operates, and evolves that platform, and to make sure SimpliSafe owns and can run what we build. You’ll manage the current platform, partner with vendors to implement the new one, and work with the Senior Manager, Data Engineering to plan the deprecation of legacy infrastructure. You’ll stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, challenge estimates, and make the calls that matter, without being your team’s sole architect.
 Who You’ll Work With 
 You’ll report to the Senior Director, Data Platform, and lead a team of core platform and data integration engineers plus a Data Architect. You’ll work closely with the Senior Manager, Data Engineering, whose team builds and operates the silver and gold pipelines that serve our Analytics and Data Science organizations. Your platform is the foundation they build on. You’ll also partner with the Senior Program Manager, who owns the integrated roadmap and executive reporting, and with Security, Privacy, and Infrastructure, who retain enterprise policy and risk accountability.
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, develop, and performance-manage platform, DevOps, and integration engineers plus the Data Architect, and manage capacity across build, migration, and legacy support.
 Own the platform roadmap. Translate target architecture into sequenced capabilities, engineering standards, and team plans, balancing new capability against reliability, cost, and technical debt.
 Own the core platform: environments, deployment patterns, orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation, delivered as self-service patterns and templates rather than a ticket queue.
 Own ingestion and integration. Build reusable frameworks across batch, replication, CDC, and API, plus standards for source onboarding, schema change, data contracts, metadata, and lineage.
 Own reliability and observability: incident response, recovery, on-call practices, monitoring, and alerting, extending coverage across data products with the Senior Manager, Data Engineering.
 Own platform cost and performance. Drive compute and workload optimization and cost visibility, in partnership with Finance and Infrastructure.
 Set architecture direction with the Data Architect on major decisions, standards, and exceptions without becoming an approval gate, and build security, privacy, access, and governance requirements into how the platform runs.
 Own technical acceptance of implementation-partner work. Define acceptance criteria, review mechanisms, and knowledge transfer so our engineers can operate the platform before handoff.
 Lead platform and ingestion migration off the legacy estate, supporting Data Engineering’s workload and data-product cutover.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 8+ years in data platform, data engineering, or infrastructure engineering , including 5+ years managing engineering teams , with a track record of hiring senior and staff engineers and growing technical leadership beneath you.
 Built and operated a modern cloud lakehouse in production (Databricks or comparable), including the environment, CI/CD, and access model, not only the workloads running on it.
 Ran a platform migration while the legacy environment stayed in production: parallel operation, reconciliation, cutover, and decommissioning.
 Led external delivery partners or vendor engineering teams. Defined technical acceptance criteria, held partners to them, and brought the capability in-house rather than leaving a dependency.
 Built ingestion at scale (batch, replication, CDC, and API) on a reusable framework, with production pipeline reliability as your responsibility.
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Databricks depth: Unity Catalog, Workflows/Jobs, Delta/DLT.
 AWS data stacks (S3, Iceberg/Delta) and streaming (Kafka).
 Owned platform cost and performance: accountable for a consumption or budget line, with specific optimizations you can point to.
 Retired or replaced in-house platform component in favor of a supported alternative.
 Consumer products, hardware, technology, or subscription businesses. 
 What Values You’ll Share 
 Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
 Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
 No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
 One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
 Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
 Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.
 What We Offer 
 A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive 
 A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here ) 
 Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home. 
 Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.
 The target annual base pay range for this role is $171,200 - $228,200.
 This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors. 
 Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here .
 We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.
 We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact [email removed] .
